input.title: League of Legends NA Community Event Kits are Back!
input.text:
Welcome to the second season of the League of Legends Community Event Support Program! Season 1 was amazing, so a big thank you to all of the event organizers and attendees that participated! Following those events, we gathered your feedback and have put together new kits for Season 2 with help from our partner, HyperX .

How Do I Apply?

For Season 2,  we’ll be supporting League of Legends events taking place in North America from June 27th to August 31st, via the application here ! If your event is chosen, you’ll be notified via email within 14 days of your application being submitted.

Community Kit Details

This season, we’ve added new,  exclusive physical and digital items to give an extra boon to your events!

Season 2 Pandemonium Community Kits:

3x HyperX Origins 2 65 Customizable, Compact Gaming Keyboards
10x Collectible Role Patches
10x Exclusive Pandemonium Mousepads
8x Exclusive Pandemonium Posters
5x Exclusive Pandemonium Keychains
20x Exclusive Pandemonium Stickers
20x Exclusive Pandemonium Lanyards
Cursed Revenant Nocturne
Fiddle Me Timbers Fiddlesticks
Blood Moon Evelynn
Arcana Tahm Kench
Coven Ward
Original Tibbers Icon
Vamporo Emote

We’re excited to hear about what you’ve got planned. Thanks so much for creating and hosting incredible events for League players, wherever you may be from!

In the meantime, check out these photos from the events that happened in Season 1!

5v5 ARAM Mayhem Tournament Ohlone College, Fremont, CA - April 10, 2026 Photo Credit: Preston D.

Sakura Anime Fest 2026 St. Clair College, Windsor, ON, Canada - April 11, 2026 Photo Credit: Shane T.

Kawaii Kon 2026 Honolulu, Hawaii - April 25, 2026 Photo Credit: Alec. T

Lakewood League XII Localhost, Boulder, CO - April 26, 2026 Photo Credit: Chris K.

Patch 26.13 Full Preview!

Senna

- Senna is the big winner of the Season 2 changes, synergizing well with Doran's Helm (gets a lot of effective health from her Q heal synergizing with the resists) as well as getting a lot of stats from Jack of All Trades

- She also synergizes well with Stattik Shiv on-hit, and we've made the decision to not support this interaction (Q CD reduction on-hit), even though it is pretty cool

- Given all this, we think she does a bit too much damage given how durable she is

Brand

- Brand changes are primarily targeted at his Bot carry tuning, while also trying to affect his support and mid less

- That said, Brand support is also often a frustrating experience for bot laners and so we think he should also sit a little lower sustainably

- Given that Brand Support synergizes better with mana regen, we're compensating through this avenue but adding some amount of mana pressure for the roles that need to use E more often

Cassiopeia

- For Cassio, we want to retain her identity of having strong all-in pressure early as that adds texture to the roster and she's one of the unique mages that can do this

- We're targeting her durability in the mid-game where she is more vulnerable, espeically in skirmishes or when she's playing on the sidelane

- This can help to keep her edges, but present more areas of vulnerability for opponents

Bard

- Bard is the top of the meta for both Pro and in many skill brackets in Solo Q

- We're adjusting how much damage his builds do, especially given his tank roaming builds tend to do a lot more damage than expected

Leblanc

- Helping Leblanc scale a little better into the Mid and Late game with this set of changes

- Given that these buffs help scaling, should also disproportionately help Solo Q

Olaf

- We're not looking to buff Olaf jungle a huge amount, given that he's already flex viable in top lane, but given that Jungle was his initial primary role, we want to make it more viable than it currently is

- A pretty simple targeted buff at his Q that should help how fast he clears, especially into the later portions of the game

RT @RiotBlueVelvet: yo-

As most of you probably know TFT is going to PBE for Set 18, Enchanted Wilds in our new Unreal Engine build today.

Since it’s gonna feel different and a bit crazier than a normal PBE cycle I wanted to jump in before it all opens up to set some expectations.

The core gameplay loop of Set 18 is all there and we’re excited for yall to get your hands on it to start cooking up comps, playing with wisps, and telling us what works and what doesn’t. But I wanna be clear that there will also be a ton of weird and pretty janky bugs/interactions that we will need to iron out over the next month such as:
•Button responsiveness: spam-clicking XP and reroll won't feel smooth and seamless yet.
•UI delays: trait icons or augment panels/tooltips might take a split second to load information the first time.
•Rubberbanding: units might visually jump back for a moment before moving into position.
•Audio/Art: some audio hiccups that play too often or lingering VFX particles that don’t clear up after fights.

and with TFT's endless combinations, there’s a ton more that we know about but also a ton that you all will help us discover in the coming days and weeks.

All of that is why we’re on PBE for a full month instead of the usual two weeks. This isn't a typical cycle for balance and normal bug bashing. We’re gonna need time to knock out the stuff I mentioned above (and more) and also test a lot of under the hood stuff. A good example of that will be quite obvious when we turn on our Ranked queue on PBE (which I'm pretty sure we have never done) to make sure all of our ranked/matchmaking systems are ready for live launch.

We expect things to break and your bug reports are what will get us to the most successful launch day possible in a month.

Quick details for today:
•Launch timing: Expect PBE to open later in the day (likely late afternoon PT) as it’s a massive deployment with all the new engine assets. There will probably be delays. Just expect it.
•Downtime: Expect more instability and intermittent downtime throughout the month as we push necessary fixes, fix crashes etc.
•Bug reporting: As you run into issues plz drop them into the r/competitiveTFT Reddit PBE megathread or the bug channels in the TFT discord. Please include the full screenshot if you have them (don’t crop and instead show all the players/full screen of game etc) or even better if you have video to include. The more information the easier it is to track down.

Thanks a ton for bearing with us through the initial days. They are gonna be messy, but helping us break things now is super valuable so we can get it crisp for live. This is a big and tbh kinda scary first step but we’re excited to have you gamers be part of this with us
